channel.title: mindoff.work
channel.description: Projects, essays, and snapshots from mindoff.work.

item.title: Git Cheat Sheet for Everyday Development
item.description: The Git commands that actually come up in real development work, explained for people in a hurry. Covers everyday workflow, merge conflicts, pull vs fetch vs rebase, undoing commits, branch cleanup, and the gitignore cache fix you'll need sooner or later.

item.title: Git Cherry-Pick. When to Use It and When to Walk Away
item.description: Git cherry-pick lets you move individual commits between branches surgically. Here's when that precision saves you and when it quietly turns into a merge problem later.

item.title: Convert Markdown to Structured JSON for Cleaner React Rendering
item.description: A Python pipeline that converts Markdown files into structured JSON, handling GitHub Gist embeds as first-class elements so React components can render text, images, and code separately.

item.title: Keeping a Prototype Honest
item.description: A useful prototype answers one risky question clearly. Polish applied before that question is answered makes an idea comfortable to approve while leaving its hardest problem untouched.

item.title: Mindoff Dataport
item.description: A Python Package to extract xlsx templates with full visual fidelity and render data-driven reports in xlsx and PDF formats.

item.title: The Four Types of Test Cases Every Python Developer Should Write
item.description: Most developers write valid-path tests and stop, unsure if they've covered enough. This four-category model gives you a repeatable system for test coverage you can actually reason about.

item.title: Django Mindoff
item.description: Architectural framework to build production-ready Django REST APIs faster with less boilerplate.
